title: COUNTROWS of a table reference does not count the blank row

source.quote: the blank row is never returned, as if it were not part of the table
source.supports: a table reference never returns the blank row

source.quote: Worth remembering that a table reference does not return

derivation: Sales rows 3 and 4 have ProductKey 9, which Product lacks, so the relationship is invalid and Product gets a blank row. A plain table reference does not include it: 3 rows.
